title: Show route legend only in wide window
goal: Use media queries to enable additional styling by viewport width.
summary: Trail route cards need to display basic routes under various windows. When the window is 640px wide, the legend used to identify road signs will be displayed.
tasks: First hide .walk-legend so that the legend in the narrow window does not take up space.
Use @media to display the legend when the viewport reaches 640px.
Both widths retain the original trail route cards.

example.note: The payment page first uses a universal width style. When the viewport reaches 700px, the rules in the query will take effect and additional service instructions will be displayed.

hint: min-width: 640px Match starting from 640px. When written as max-width the rule uses the other side.
